title: Design System: OHMI electronics workspace — M1 local preview

motion.name: shared-button-feedback
motion.purpose: Inherited shared Button state feedback; active scale is 0.98 and global reduced-motion rules apply.

body.purpose: React shell notice, status and footer. The native editor retains its own bundled fonts.

components.name: Run button
components.description: Shared primary button starts native simulation; disabled while loading or busy.

components.name: Secondary circuit control
components.description: Shared outline control for views, file actions, Stop and history.

components.name: Local saving notice
components.description: A flat secondary surface explains local-only storage and simulation limits.
components.html: Download your circuit before leaving. Cloud saving and AI building are not connected in this preview.

components.name: Workspace return link
components.description: Visible text link participates in the shared local-work exit guard.

components.name: Engine status
components.description: Polite text status names loading, ready and local file outcomes without claiming cloud persistence.
components.html: Changes stay in this tab until downloaded.

narrative.overview: This local preview inherits the existing OHMI Operate interface. A compact React control area surrounds the native designElectronics canvas; it does not introduce a new visual identity. This file records M1 only. The application-wide authority remains web-app/DESIGN.md, with product constraints in web-app/PRODUCT.md and phase boundaries in ../PLAN.md.
keyCharacteristics: Light mode by default; mint actions on pale study surfaces and neutral charcoal in dark mode.
Familiar labeled controls, restrained borders and the unchanged canonical OHMI mascot in the shared shell.
Native technical canvas retained; no new illustrations, mascot variants or decorative motion.

rules.name: The Technical Canvas Rule
rules.body: Theme the surrounding controls without recoloring physical part markings or making schematic symbols unreadable.

rules.name: The Local Work Rule
rules.body: Keep local-only saving explicit: students must download .dez before leaving. File replacement, reload and workspace exit require confirmation; canceling navigation retains the runtime and circuit.

dos: Do reuse the existing semantic tokens, shared Button and exact approved mascot.
Do preserve the native technical rendering and disclose simulation limits.
Do distinguish local-preview verification from production readiness.
donts: Don't infer full canvas accessibility from the surrounding DOM controls.
Don't treat the heading exception, upstream canvas geometry or incidental test toasts as new application-wide design rules.
Don't add replacement mascot art, visual AI controls or cloud-save claims to M1.
